title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone like a monolith.
body:
The current model for digital news is stuck in a loop. Algorithms are designed to keep you clicking, not to help you understand what is actually happening in the world. They feed you whatever is loud and controversial, regardless of whether it fits your life or your interests.

We believe the future of news is about signal, not noise. Personalization shouldn't mean being trapped in a bubble of opinions you already agree with. True personalization means giving you the context you need to form your own perspective.

Our roadmap focuses on building tools that respect your time. We are working on ways to summarize complex stories into clear, digestible briefings that cut through the clutter. The goal is to make sure that when you check the news, you walk away smarter than when you started.

Technology should be a filter that clarifies the world, not a megaphone that amplifies chaos. We are building the kind of news experience we actually want to use every single morning.
cta: See how we are rethinking the daily briefing at HEADLINNE.com.
